title: Igama Elinikwe Ngaphambi Kokuzalwa
intro: Khawucinge ngendlu engcwele ezolileyo egcwele umthandazo onyanisekileyo emva kweminyaka emininzi yokulinda. Kwizinto ezingabonakaliyo kuvela impendulo ephethe igama elingazange linikwe ngaphambili, ubulumko obuthembisayo beminyaka yokuqala kunye nobomi obuphawulwe kukuzinikela, inceba, nobunyulu.
clues: Ndathiywa igama nguAllah ngokwakhe ngaphambi kokuba ndizalwe, igama engazange linikwe mntu ngaphambi kwam.
Ndanikwa njengempendulo kwisicelo esinyanisekileyo sabazali abadala ababecinga ukuba ukuzala akunakwenzeka.
Ndandibahlonipha abazali bam kwaye ndinovelwano kwabanye, kwaye ndandingenakratshi okanye ndingathobeli.
U-Allah wamisela uxolo kum ngomhla endazalwa ngawo, ngomhla endiya kufa ngawo, nangomhla endiya kuvuswa ngawo ndiphila.
Ubawo uZakariya wafumana iindaba ezimnandi ngam kwiingelosi ngelixa emi ethandaza kwindawo engcwele (mihrab).

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌۭ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرٌۭ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ
verse: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when I have reached old age and my wife is barren?" He [the angel] said, "Such is Allāh; He does what He wills." (3:40)
